error_summary: 模型跳过 raster-to-point 人口值提取步骤，改用地震震级 `mag` 作为热力图权重，还额外筛选 mag>=4；结果表达的是地震强度/事件分布，而不是地震影响区域的人口集中程度。

result_previews.description: 错误流程用地震震级作为热力图变量，未表达人口集中程度。

reference_basis: 依据 GeoBenchX 参考工具链 `get_values_from_raster_with_geometries` 和本地 USA 1km 人口栅格重新提取地震点位人口值

evidence_metrics.human_reasoning: The candidate solution does not match to any of the reference solutions. It does load correct datasets, but misses important step 'get_values_from_raster_with_geometries' to get population in earthquakes locations and produces heatmap of earthquakes instead of population. Also it contains extra step "filter_numerical" to select major earthquakes though the task does not require this.
